scope: Complete pinned Henry Spencer V7 distribution: sources, installed scripts, supporting assets, kernel/boot references and historical binaries. Native ports remain separate from preserved reference inputs.
coverage: Every one of the 2144 distribution files is explicitly owned by a component and checked against the archive provenance index. Source availability is separate from inventory coverage and native implementation status.
dependency_policy: Confirmed edges have local evidence; inferred edges and unresolved audits are explicit. Cycles are allowed for toolchain bootstrap and runtime generators. This is not a completed symbol-level compatibility audit.
timestamp_policy: Preserve V7 atime/mtime/ctime semantics and on-disk widths; no birth-time field or higher precision.

requirements.description: Host GCC/binutils bootstrap native Nexix ELF builds; retained native tools remain unported.
Native public headers are installed and tested without host headers. Seven application-owned format headers retain their explicit consumer tasks; see docs/header-coverage.json.
Native V7 process/filesystem/TTY/device/syscall ABI and architecture equivalents through tasks 76-82 are implemented and tested; later programs retain consumer acceptance.

Native x87/MMX/SSE state isolation, signal FP contexts, binary64 helpers, decimal conversion/formatting and retained libm C sources are implemented; full libc coverage and installed math headers/archive remain pending.
UTC wall clock is initialized from RTC at boot; V7 inode timestamps and sync superblock time use the system clock and persist in the existing disk encoding.
Native gmtime/localtime/asctime/ctime, V7 timezone/ftime, and configurable TZ: fixed offsets, one-hour DST with M rules or historical V7 US defaults; unsupported TZ falls back to GMT.
Native account databases, DES authentication, owned homes/profiles, shared V7 temporary files, automatic two-line getty/login, passwd, su and newgrp are installed and tested.
